import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

root = Path('/home/administrator/projects/hexalith/tenants')
out = root / '_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts'
entry = json.loads((out / 'dw-112-entry-state.json').read_text())
backup = Path('/tmp/hexalith-dw112/entry')
allowed = {
    'src/Hexalith.Tenants.UI/Components/Pages/TenantsWorkspace.razor',
    'tests/Hexalith.Tenants.UI.Tests/Browser/validate-tenants-focus-browser.sh',
    '_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md',
    '_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/release-readiness.md',
    'docs/maintenance-backlog.md',
}

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

changed = [name for name, digest in entry['owning_file_hashes'].items() if sha(root / name) != digest]
assert set(changed) == allowed, changed
repositories = {}
for name, recorded in entry['repositories'].items():
    comparisons = {}
    for key, original in recorded.items():
        if name == '.' and key in ('status', 'diff'):
            continue
        result = subprocess.run(original['argv'], cwd=root / name, capture_output=True, text=True)
        comparisons[key] = result.returncode == original['exit_code'] and result.stdout + result.stderr == original['output']
    assert all(comparisons.values()), (name, comparisons)
    repositories[name] = comparisons

prior = json.loads((out / 'dw-105-108-entry-state.json').read_text())
historical = {name: sha(root / 'references/Hexalith.EventStore' / name) == digest
              for name, digest in prior['inherited_eventstore_historical_sha256'].items()}
assert len(historical) == 1371 and all(historical.values())
dirty_dependency = {}
for name, repository in prior['repositories'].items():
    for file, digest in repository.get('dirty_file_sha256', {}).items():
        path = root / name / file
        dirty_dependency[str(Path(name) / file)] = sha(path) == digest
assert all(dirty_dependency.values()), dirty_dependency

ledger = '_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md'
def records(text):
    return {int(match.group(1)): match.group(0) for match in re.finditer(
        r'^### DW-(\d+):.*?(?=^### DW-|\Z)', text, re.M | re.S)}
current_records = records((root / ledger).read_text())
original_records = records((backup / ledger).read_text())
assert set(current_records) == set(original_records) == set(range(1, 644))
changed_records = [number for number in current_records if current_records[number] != original_records[number]]
assert changed_records == [112], changed_records
counts = collections.Counter()
dispositions = collections.Counter()
open_ids = set()
for number, record in current_records.items():
    status = re.search(r'^status: (.+)$', record, re.M).group(1)
    if status.startswith('done '):
        counts['done'] += 1
    else:
        assert status == 'open', (number, status)
        counts['open'] += 1
        open_ids.add(number)
        dispositions[re.search(r'^disposition: (.+)$', record, re.M).group(1)] += 1
assert counts == {'done': 322, 'open': 321}, counts
assert dispositions == {'actionable': 233, 'blocked': 15, 'awaiting-decision': 26,
                        'accepted-limitation': 9, 'uncertain': 38}, dispositions
# Preserve the documented original reconciliation boundary: 204 older closed records.
reconciled_done = counts['done'] - 204
assert reconciled_done == 118

index = 'docs/maintenance-backlog.md'
def index_rows(text):
    return [line for line in text.splitlines() if re.match(r'^\| DW-\d+', line)]
rows = index_rows((root / index).read_text())
entry_rows = index_rows((backup / index).read_text())
assert rows == [line for line in entry_rows if not line.startswith('| DW-112 |')]
indexed = collections.Counter(int(n) for line in rows for n in re.findall(r'DW-(\d+)', line.split('|')[1]))
assert set(indexed) == open_ids and all(count == 1 for count in indexed.values())
assert len(rows) == 286
readiness = '_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/release-readiness.md'
assert (root / readiness).read_bytes().startswith((backup / readiness).read_bytes())
runner = 'tests/Hexalith.Tenants.UI.Tests/Browser/validate-tenants-focus-browser.sh'
assert (root / runner).read_bytes().startswith((backup / runner).read_bytes())

ledger_result = {
    'closed_ids': [112], 'all_ids': len(current_records), 'all_counts': counts,
    'original_older_closed_boundary': 204, 'reconciled_done': reconciled_done,
    'open_dispositions': dispositions, 'index_rows': len(rows), 'index_open_ids': len(indexed),
    'exact_once_coverage': True, 'unrelated_records_byte_identical': True,
    'historical_readiness_prefix_preserved': True,
    'unrelated_record_sha256': {str(n): hashlib.sha256(r.encode()).hexdigest()
                                for n, r in current_records.items() if n != 112},
}
(out / 'dw-112-ledger-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(ledger_result, indent=2) + '\n')
sources = [
    'src/Hexalith.Tenants.UI/Components/Pages/TenantsWorkspace.razor',
    'src/Hexalith.Tenants.UI/wwwroot/js/tenantsStatusFilter.js',
    'tests/Hexalith.Tenants.UI.Tests/Components/StatusFilterLabelRenderingTests.cs',
    'tests/Hexalith.Tenants.UI.Tests/Browser/validate-status-filter-label-browser.mjs', runner,
]
built = [f'{folder}/bin/{configuration}/net10.0/{assembly}.dll'
         for configuration in ['Debug', 'Release']
         for folder, assembly in [('src/Hexalith.Tenants.UI', 'Hexalith.Tenants.UI'),
                                  ('tests/Hexalith.Tenants.UI.Tests', 'Hexalith.Tenants.UI.Tests')]]
result = {
    'all_checks_passed': True, 'changed_existing_files': changed,
    'unchanged_owning_entry_files': len(entry['owning_file_hashes']) - len(changed),
    'repositories': repositories,
    'inherited_eventstore_historical_hashes_compared_to_preserved_prior_entry': historical,
    'inherited_dependency_dirty_hashes_compared_to_preserved_prior_entry': dirty_dependency,
    'prior_entry_sha256': sha(out / 'dw-105-108-entry-state.json'),
    'current_entry_sha256': sha(out / 'dw-112-entry-state.json'),
    'source_sha256': {name: sha(root / name) for name in sources},
    'built_artifact_sha256': {name: sha(root / name) for name in built},
    'original_browser_runner_prefix_preserved': True,
    'unrelated_index_rows_unchanged': True, 'unrelated_ledger_records_byte_identical': True,
    'original_readiness_prefix_preserved': True,
    'verification_script': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
(out / 'dw-112-preservation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'all_checks_passed': True, 'all_ids': len(current_records), 'counts': counts,
                  'reconciled_done': reconciled_done, 'dispositions': dispositions, 'index_rows': len(rows),
                  'unchanged_owning_files': result['unchanged_owning_entry_files'],
                  'historical_files': len(historical), 'dirty_dependency_files': len(dirty_dependency)}))
